row.notes: Picks the tab to focus from the mode int at (+0x268)->+0x1a8->+4: 9 or 0xe selects tab hash of tabbing_secondary_controller, 0x12 selects garage_monitor_panel_tt_leaderboard; otherwise if +0x948 is set it looks for a pending programme (+0x184 flag) and selects garage_monitor_panel_data_tab (copying its id into tab +0x63c and clearing the flags) else garage_monitor_panel_practice_select_alt; if +0x948 is clear it tries the list elements of +0x798 in order. Tabs live in +0x408..+0x410 and selection goes through Ui_Resolve_MyTeamTabNode(self +0x420).
